thread:
priya: Heads-up: cost dashboard flagged a model-level unit cost variance that correlates with yesterday's sticky-routing rollout. Looks specific to the batcher-prefetch path and only for a subset of tenants. :grimacing:
harry: which model and window?
priya: m-lite-3, window 2026-04-09T22:15:00Z -> 2026-04-09T23:00:00Z. Query I ran: `SELECT route, model, SUM(tokens)*unit_price AS raw_cost, SUM(kv_credit) AS credits FROM token_events WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-04-09T22:15:00Z' AND '2026-04-09T23:00:00Z' GROUP BY route,model` -> prefetch shows credits=0 for many rows while traces show prefetch hits.
adele: router emitted `x-routing=sticky-prefetch` in the same window?
jon: logs do show `x-routing=sticky-prefetch` but the batcher sometimes collapses headers when we multiplex. I suspect header collapse lost the `x-cache-credit` tag before econ-ingest.
priya: that would explain it. UX problem: dashboard surfaces raw token cost and product folks are getting paged. We should present provisional costs instead of raw when credits are likely to be applied.
harry: short term: add a dashboard affordance "provisional credits" column with a tooltip explaining "credits may be applied after reconciliation" and a link to the live reconciler run. Also add an indicator when rows overlap active rollouts.
adele: backend plan: 1) make econ-ingest resilient to header collapse by accepting a cookie-stamped cache tag `rw_cache_tag` emitted by batcher as fallback; 2) run a reconciler that scans for invocations with route='prefetch' and missing credit rows for the last 72h and computes an estimated credit.
jon: reconciler sketch: ```-- reconciler backfill
INSERT INTO econ_adjustments (invocation_id, estimated_credit, note)
SELECT i.id,
       LEAST(i.estimated_kv_savings, i.token_cost * 0.75) AS estimated_credit,
       'batcher-header-collapse-backfill'
FROM invocations i
LEFT JOIN econ_adjustments e ON e.invocation_id = i.id
WHERE i.route = 'prefetch'
  AND i.ts > now() - interval '72 hours'
  AND e.invocation_id IS NULL;
```
priya: make sure estimated backfills are flagged so billing/UI treats them as provisional. Also emit an audit_event per backfilled invocation so finance can reconcile.
harry: alerting: add a non-pager econ-alert when (sum(raw_cost) - sum(post_credit_cost)) / sum(raw_cost) > 0.35 for > 10m for any tenant cohort. Don't page SRE until > 1% billing delta sustained for 1h.
adele: can we also add a canary-safe dashboard toggle so customers in the canary cohort see post-credit estimates by default? that might reduce confusion.
jon: pausing the sticky-prefetch rollout for safety. infra-bot: action queued: pause-rollout sticky-prefetch (reason: econ-credit-validation)
priya: i'll open ENG-7640 (batcher header resilience + reconciler), ENG-7641 (dashboard provisional credits), ENG-7642 (e2e test for header-collapse). Adele, can you mock the batcher behavior in staging so we can run the reconciler against synthetic traces?
adele: yup, i'll spin up a synthetic run and ping when done.
harry: also add a tiny UX banner when credits are provisional: "Post-credit costs are estimated; final billing may differ after reconciliation." Color the rows with estimated credits in amber.
priya: thanks team. i'll post a short note to product and finance advising them that we're investigating and will backfill credits if reconciler deems them valid. Will follow up with a short postmortem if backfill impacts invoices. :thumbsup:
